name: Joint initial 34-product 35-electrical-configuration extended screening
method: Complex 0D sealed box: I/U=1/(Re+jwLe+BL²/Zm), Zm=Rms+jwMms+1/(jwCms)+Sd² rho c²/(jwVb), v/U=BL I/(Zm U); coherent RMS. U capped by Xmax, I²Re budget, sqrt(4*Pamp) nominal resistor-equivalent; SPL simple freefield half-space 1m piston approximation. Source BL/Mms fallback is derived from self-consistent small-signal parameters; 1kHz Le used in 20Hz approximate transfer where DC Le unavailable.
limits: Not actual clean SPL, distortion/IMD, amplifier clip at complex 1.5/6/8Ω, dynamic coil temperature, real cabinet gas or measured T/S. Bare watt ratings not universally comparable. This is a CROSS-POOL FIRST SCREEN, NOT full reproduction of all 26 original P01–P30 experiments.
